description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the acquisitions of the land in Matthumagala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically deals with the deposit of statutory compensation for acquired land, including details about the land's location, lot number, extent, and the deposited amount. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
